        trigger = { ywc_oir_fed_at_1229 = yes ywc_oir_fed_setback_available = yes }
        ai_chance = { base = 60 }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_oir.1229.close_setback.cost_tooltip }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_oir.1229.close_setback.consequence_tooltip }
        if = { limit = { ywc_oir_fed_at_1229 = yes ywc_oir_fed_setback_available = yes } ywc_oir_fed_close_setback = yes }
    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_oir.1229.withdraw_at_1229
        ai_chance = { base = 0 }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_oir.1229.withdraw_at_1229.cost_tooltip }

        if = { limit = { ywc_oir_fed_at_1229 = yes } ywc_oir_fed_close_withdrawn = yes }
    }
}
